about: Real answers of four blind reviewers (no sound, no script) on contact sheets of four renders of the paper_factory short. v1 and v2: the jar falls on the red worker's side (defect). v3 and final: it falls on the green worker's side, as the brief says. bump_fall and stars_night of v1/v2 were answered 'partiel' and are recoded 'contradicts' (the description says the opposite of the brief). Cell times of the v1-v3 sheets are approximate (+0.083 s from the nominal grid, measured on v3).

verdicts.observed: s00 #2-#3: a grey slatted shutter covers the doorway of a red paper factory with a sun sign above it. #4 (0.83 s): the shutter has lifted to about half height and a yellow spiral sun shows underneath. #5 (1.08 s): the doorway is fully open, the sun fills it.

who_does_what.who: grey shutter on the red factory

The red-overalls worker (left, holding a tall white pole) and the green-overalls mustached worker (right, waving) stand in front with a jar on a crate between them.

Each band is visibly rolled across by the roller at the end of the red worker's handle. By s08 #7 the roller is lowered.

watches, then raises arms in cheer (s08 #8)

Green worker cheers with both arms up throughout.

other_findings.finding: Attribution: the jar falls and breaks at the RED worker's feet while the green worker's arm points at it. A viewer reads either 'green pushed the jar onto red' or 'green points at red: it's your fault' — the brief wants it to fall on green's side.
Green worker walks forward/left INTO the crate rather than stepping back in excitement; no backward step visible.
Abrupt zoom-out between s04 #5 and #6 (crane appears suddenly); also zoom-ins at s12 #8 and s18 #3. Fine if eased, jarring if cut.
The sun stays high in the night sky among stars until ~18.5 s, then sinks behind the hills (s18 #3-#6) with no one acting on it; may puzzle a viewer (night before dusk).
The brief places the blue worker at the crane controls; on screen he first appears inside the factory pushing the sun, then walks to the crane by s08 #7. Not a defect, just differs from brief.

other_findings.note: ATTRIBUTION: the jar ends up on the ground at the red worker's feet, LEFT of the crate, and the red worker is the one reaching toward it with a red object (looks like the jar's red lid or his roller head) in hand. A viewer will likely read the accident as the red worker's doing, not the green one's.
The star burst envelops the red worker, reinforcing the wrong attribution.
Green worker moves TOWARD the crate (leftward), not backward; there is no visible 'stepping back' motion.
Star cloud gathers over the factory doorway/sign before rising; could read as stars going into the factory rather than spilling into the sky.
Blue worker jumps from behind the sun on the conveyor (s08 #7) to the crane controls (s08 #8) within one cell; minor.
Green worker winks at camera at the start; harmless, mentioned for completeness.

other_findings.note: Opens on a near-blank cream frame fading in; harmless.

The green worker approaches the crate by stepping sideways/left toward it and then jumping, not by stepping back; viewers will read 'he jumped for joy into the crate' rather than 'he backed into it'. Attribution is unaffected.

The sun visibly sets behind the hills as night falls (s16 #8, s18 #1-#3): the night can read as the ordinary end of the dusk rather than as caused by the stars, though the stars-then-dark-band sequence still links them.
The jar's red lid flies off and lands on the crate (s16 #4), and the empty jar becomes a pale blue block that reads as an ice cube or glass brick rather than a jar.
The crane enters by a camera pan/zoom out at ~4.8 s; the red worker's roller pole is so long it crosses the whole frame, slightly hard to read as a roller at first.

other_findings.note: Between 9.5 s (s08 #7) and 9.75 s (s08 #8) the blue worker jumps from beside the sun at the doorway to the crane control box at the far right, and the red worker's long paint pole vanishes; reads as a pop / position jump rather than a walk.
